variants.headline: Looking back: home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had changed the colony's charter.

Our movement believes the rules of public authority deserve political argument, not ceremonial submission. A charter shapes the relationship between the colony and the home world. The question of legitimacy should therefore remain visible, without pretending that a general principle tells us the exact content of this particular amendment.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

This paper examines {target} through the fact of the amendment, without announcing a specific legal effect not contained in the report. The exercise of authority and its justification merit separate scrutiny.
